Pilibhit to Host Leopard Safari; Snake Venom Extraction Planned for Lucknow

The Uttar Pradesh government has approved a plan to introduce leopard safaris in Pilibhit. This initiative aims to allow tourists to experience leopard sightings. Additionally, a facility for snake venom extraction is planned for Lucknow as part of the broader scheme.
